Velkoz|mid.identity: Artillery mage dealing magic and true damage, played mid about one game in five (support is his main role). Plasma Fission (Q) splits at a right angle to hit behind minions, Void Rift (W) strikes in a line twice, Tectonic Disruption (E) knocks up after a delay, and Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) channels a ray that deals true damage to targets he has already researched. Three ability hits on a target trigger true damage (passive).
Velkoz|mid.playstyle: In mid, Vel'Koz is a long-range poke and burst mage, more damage-focused than in support. He clears waves with W and pokes with Q.
Velkoz|mid.early_game: Farm with W (which hits the whole line of minions) and poke with a split Q. Keep E to defend against an engage: the knock-up lands after a short delay, so anticipate.
Velkoz|mid.level_1: Plasma Fission (Q) first. Poke by splitting Q behind minions.
Velkoz|mid.level_2: Void Rift (W). Clear the wave and poke in a line.
Velkoz|mid.level_3: Tectonic Disruption (E). Combo: E (knock-up) → W → Q → true damage passive.
Velkoz|mid.level_6: Disintegration Ray: a channeled ray that follows your cursor. Cast it after E on a rooted target or on a grouped team. You can cancel it if needed.
power_spikes: First completed item: long-range poke and burst.
Velkoz|mid.lane_plan: Clear the wave with W, poke with a split Q and keep E for defense. Push, then join objectives. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you reset after pushing.
Velkoz|mid.trading: Short trade: split Q. All-in: E → W → Q → R. Give up on it against assassins who dive you (LeBlanc) or roam around you (Twisted Fate).
threats: Twisted Fate, who roams while you poke.
mistakes: Channeling the ray within an assassin's range.
Casting E without anticipating the delay.

matchup_notes.Viktor: Poke him with a split Q and W.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep E for the end of her ultimate.
matchup_notes.Syndra: A range duel: dodge her stun.
matchup_notes.LeBlanc: She bursts you before you can react: farm under your tower.

Velkoz|mid.mid_game: Poke before objectives and ray on grouped teams.
Velkoz|mid.late_game: Artillery: poke, E on the enemy engage and ray on the group. Stay behind your frontline.
Velkoz|mid.ahead: Poke before objectives and take towers.
Velkoz|mid.behind: Farm from range and play with your team.
Velkoz|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to poke the enemy team before fights and finish them with your ray.
Velkoz|mid.final_tip: Split your Q behind minions: it's how you poke without getting blocked.
